page.overview:
What is Abbey of the Moon?

Abbey of the Moon belongs to Dungeons & Dragons. The Abbey of the Moon was a temple to Selûne that existed during the days of Netheril.

During that time it was considered to be one of the most revered holy sites for that goddess. And long after its destruction, it was held in fond memory by the Netherese. This abbey was located in the Abbey Mountains, atop its highest peak — the Selune Crest.
